records.translation: RAM de la cola de escritura en base de datos

records.key: RAM allowed for serialized data waiting for Measure's single database writer. Overflow is stored in a private temporary folder inside measurements. Zero uses disk-only buffering. This limits queued data, not total process memory. Applies to new runs.
records.source: RAM allowed for serialized data waiting for Measure's single database writer. Overflow is stored in a private temporary folder inside measurements. Zero uses disk-only buffering. This limits queued data, not total process memory. Applies to new runs.
records.translation: RAM permitida para datos serializados que esperan al único escritor de base de datos de Measure. El exceso se guarda en una carpeta temporal privada dentro de measurements. Cero utiliza almacenamiento intermedio solo en disco. Limita los datos en cola, no la memoria total del proceso. Se aplica a ejecuciones nuevas.
